title: Repo management skill series (cluster anchor): hygiene as enforced knowledge
desc: Cluster anchor for the repo-management series -- one skill per repo-hygiene concern (GC, 400-line splitting, ASCII-only source, sandbox-suffix naming, file placement, commit hygiene). Repo cleanliness is enforced knowledge, not vibes. Grows one-by-one as each concern is hit.
steps: PHILOSOPHY (user 2026-06-18): repo MANAGEMENT itself deserves a SKILL SERIES -- one skill per concern -- because a messy repo is token-hostile to every future AI session and silent drift (orphans, oversized files, encoding traps) compounds. Treat repo hygiene as ENFORCED knowledge (a wkdoctor check + a tool), never a one-off cleanup. The series grows ONE-BY-ONE as each concern is encountered.

SERIES MEMBERS (so far): (1) [[repo-garbage-collector-unused-file-quarantine]] -- quarantine UNUSED files to .tmp/unused-<ts>/ (reversible); (2) [[ascii-only-source-no-decorative-unicode]] -- .ps1/source must be pure ASCII (no box-drawing/bullet/smart-quote), the pre-commit gate blocks them; (3) [[wksplit-cs-utility]] -- the 400-line soft cap + 0-token deterministic splitter; cluster also touches sandbox-suffix naming (-proto/-demix/-bak/-probe), file placement (one canonical home + shim, see [[willkim-tool-harness-independence-install-location]]), and encoding (UTF-8 canonical, ASCII for .ps1).

HOW THE SERIES IS USED: each member is (a) a wkdoctor health CHECK that surfaces the problem in the routine checkup, AND (b) a TOOL/discipline that fixes it conservatively + reversibly. Verify every tool with synthetic/live/static ([[verify-tool-or-guard-synthetic-live-static]]).

ADDING A MEMBER: when you hit a new repo-hygiene concern (a trap, a mess, a drift), capture it as a NEW skill, add a member line here, and -- if mechanizable -- a wkdoctor check + a tool. Keep this anchor the single index. Cluster: [[wkdoctor-system-physician]], [[hongik-harness-modular-independence-design]].

SERIES MEMBER (4) added 2026-06-18: [[commit-push-hook-policy-overview]] -- the single index of the git commit/push hook policy (pre-commit ASCII + cheap-source + model-tag + todo gates; pre-push model-tier + no-verify; harness PreToolUse --no-* / hooksPath / gpgsign / WKHARNESS_AGENT_MODEL blocks; and the un-bypassable teeth = server-side CI + branch protection). It consolidated ~8 scattered skills that had no overview.
